Light cleaning pipeline (EDA)

Source: R/pipeline.R
pipeline_light_clean.Rd

Minimal pipeline + deduplication + soft imputation.

Usage

pipeline_light_clean(
  data,
  required_columns = NULL,
  strict = TRUE,
  dedup_keys = NULL,
  dedup_keep = c("first", "last"),
  num_method = "median",
  cat_method = "mode",
  num_constant = 0,
  cat_constant = "Missing",
  impute_verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame.

required_columns

Optional character vector of required columns.

strict

Stop on missing required columns when TRUE (default).

dedup_keys

Character vector of columns used to detect duplicates (after standardisation). If NULL, all columns are used.

dedup_keep

Which duplicate to keep: "first" (default) or "last".

num_method

Imputation method for numeric columns ("median", "mean", "constant").

cat_method

Imputation method for categorical columns ("mode", "constant", "new_level").

num_constant

Value used when num_method = "constant".

cat_constant

Value used when cat_method is "constant" or "new_level".

impute_verbose

Logical, passed to impute_missing.

Value

A deduplicated and lightly imputed data.frame.
